description:
Search indexed Istanbul event sessions; verify candidates with istanbul_event_detail.

    Returns source-attributed event cards with ticket_url, about.text excerpts,
    price_quote, timing_kind (scheduled vs flexible_entry), participation_conditions
    and result_info diagnostics. Unknown prices are never free or verified within
    budget; Ticketmaster is catalogue-only and Biletinial list rows need detail
    verification. Read istanbul://guides/events for full pricing/timing semantics.

budget_includes_fees.description: Require observed fee inclusion when evaluating max_price_try.
budget_includes_fees.title: Budget Includes Fees

category.description: Category or Turkish alias: concert, theatre, opera_ballet, standup, family, festival, exhibition, workshop, sport, seminar, other.
category.title: Category

child_age.description: Child age (0-17); requires a published matching family age range.
child_age.title: Child Age

date_from.description: Start date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow (Europe/Istanbul, default today).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: End date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow (max 31-day span, default +7 days).
date_to.title: Date To

exclude_child_only.description: Exclude events with published upper age limit below 18.
exclude_child_only.title: Exclude Child Only

free_only.description: Require observed zero price; unknown prices are excluded.
free_only.title: Free Only

include_past.description: Include retained active sessions that already started.
include_past.title: Include Past

include_sold_out.description: Include explicitly sold-out sessions for inspection.
include_sold_out.title: Include Sold Out

include_unknown_prices.description: Include events without observed prices; set false for verified budgets only.
include_unknown_prices.title: Include Unknown Prices

lat.description: WGS84 latitude (must be paired with lon).
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: WGS84 longitude (must be paired with lat).
lon.title: Lon

max_price_try.description: Max observed TRY price (whole-party subtotal when party/party_size is set).
max_price_try.title: Max Price Try

party.description: Mixed group counts by profile, e.g. {'adult': 2, 'child': 1}.
party.title: Party

party_size.description: Group size (1-50) for observed party ticket subtotals.
party_size.title: Party Size

query.description: Title search text (empty = no text filter).
query.title: Query

radius_m.description: Straight-line search radius in meters (default 5000, max 20000).
radius_m.title: Radius M

ticket_profile.description: Attendee ticket profile: general, adult, student, child, senior, or any.
ticket_profile.title: Ticket Profile

time_from.description: Earliest session start clock (HH:MM). Excludes date-only flexible tickets.
time_from.title: Time From

time_to.description: Latest session start clock (HH:MM). Excludes date-only flexible tickets.
time_to.title: Time To

name: istanbul_events_search

license.default: Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License

url.description: Human-readable source page for citations; null when the source is only an API endpoint or data file.

title: İstanbul etkinlik arama
